raw_text: DEVELOPING: Maldives government has reportedly signed a military cooperation agreement with China. Deal includes provisions for joint exercises and a Chinese-funded coast guard facility on Marao atoll. This follows expulsion of Indian military personnel under the 'India Out' campaign. Major shift in Maldivian strategic alignment.
